selected_evidence.requirement: Create and install OS Comparison Root CA as a trusted system CA
selected_evidence.summary: Created the CA, confirmed its exact subject and CA extensions, verified key/certificate correspondence, and successfully validated an issued leaf through RHEL's system trust bundle.

Captured healthy pre-restart state, received reboot acknowledgement, proved the boot ID changed from e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 to 7e79df65-3864-4af9-bc44-3a45f7b496f1, and confirmed the system, CA files, key match, root trust, and leaf verification recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
key=/root/.local-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key
cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
if [ -e "$key" ] || [ -e "$cert" ]; then
  printf 'existing_artifact_detected\n'
  ls -l "$key" "$cert" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
fi
printf 'paths_clear\n'

set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 700 /root/.local-ca
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 \
  -keyout /root/.local-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 600 /root/.local-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'ca_created_and_trust_extracted\n'

set -eu
cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key=/root/.local-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf '%s\n' '--- certificate identity ---'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
printf '%s\n' '--- certificate CA extensions ---'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+5p'
printf '%s\n' '--- protected artifacts ---'
stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' "$key" "$cert"
printf '%s\n' '--- public-key match ---'
key_hash=$(openssl pkey -in "$key" -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
cert_hash=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'private_key_public_hash=%s\ncertificate_public_hash=%s\n' "$key_hash" "$cert_hash"
test "$key_hash" = "$cert_hash"
printf '%s\n' '--- verification through generated system trust ---'
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$cert"

commands.command:
set -eu
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/os-ca-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj '/CN=os-comparison-validation.local' \
  -keyout "$tmpdir/leaf.key" -out "$tmpdir/leaf.csr" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectAltName=DNS:os-comparison-validation.local\n' > "$tmpdir/leaf.ext"
openssl x509 -req -in "$tmpdir/leaf.csr" \
  -CA /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -CAkey /root/.local-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -set_serial 2 -days 365 -sha256 -extfile "$tmpdir/leaf.ext" \
  -out "$tmpdir/leaf.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- issued leaf ---'
openssl x509 -in "$tmpdir/leaf.crt" -noout -subject -issuer
printf '%s\n' '--- leaf verification using RHEL system trust ---'
openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname os-comparison-validation.local \
  -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$tmpdir/leaf.crt"
commands.stdout:

cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

set -eu

cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key=/root/.local-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'old_boot_id=%s\nnew_boot_id=%s\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
test "$new_boot" != "$old_boot"

printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
stat -c 'post_restart_artifact=%A %a %U:%G %n' "$key" "$cert"

printf 'post_restart_issuer='; openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -issuer
printf 'post_restart_fingerprint='; openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -fingerprint -sha256
printf 'post_restart_root_trust='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$cert"
key_hash=$(openssl pkey -in "$key" -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
cert_hash=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
test "$key_hash" = "$cert_hash"
printf 'post_restart_key_match=yes hash=%s\n' "$key_hash"
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/os-ca-post-restart.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmpdir/leaf.key" "$tmpdir/leaf.csr" "$tmpdir/leaf.ext" "$tmpdir/leaf.crt"; rmdir "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj '/CN=os-comparison-validation.local' -keyout "$tmpdir/leaf.key" -out "$tmpdir/leaf.csr" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectAltName=DNS:os-comparison-validation.local\n' > "$tmpdir/leaf.ext"
openssl x509 -req -in "$tmpdir/leaf.csr" -CA "$cert" -CAkey "$key" -set_serial 3 -days 365 -sha256 -extfile "$tmpdir/leaf.ext" -out "$tmpdir/leaf.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'post_restart_leaf_issuer='; openssl x509 -in "$tmpdir/leaf.crt" -noout -issuer
printf 'post_restart_leaf_trust='; openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname os-comparison-validation.local -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$tmpdir/leaf.crt"
